hints.phone: Hold a small flat thing in your hand, tap and swipe it with a thumb, then press it to your ear.
hints.computer: Sit and type fast on a keyboard, click and drag with a mouse, and stare at the screen.
hints.camera: Hold a box up to one eye, twist a lens, and press a button on top with a click.
hints.robot: Move in stiff, jerky steps with straight arms, turn your head in sharp clicks, and stiffly offer a handshake.
hints.television: Sit back on a couch, point a remote, flip through channels, and watch with wide eyes.
hints.headphones: Put both hands on your ears like cups, bob your head to a beat, and ignore people around you.
hints.keyboard: Spread your fingers and type fast on a wide board in front of you, then hit a big key hard.
hints.mouse: Hold a small thing under your palm, slide it around, and click with your finger.
hints.laptop: Open a lid like a clamshell on your knees, type on it, and then snap it shut.
hints.battery: Show a small cylinder, slot it in, then act a toy dying slowly and being brought back to life.
hints.selfie: Hold your arm out far, turn your face, pout and smile, then check how the picture looks.
hints.drone: Hold a remote with two thumbs, make a small thing buzz and hover in the air, and watch it from below.
hints.video call: Wave at a small screen, freeze when it lags, and tilt your head in confusion.
hints.printer: Press a button, listen to a machine whir, slide out a sheet, and look annoyed when it jams.
hints.smartwatch: Tap your wrist, check it as you run, and look at it to read a message.
hints.charger: Plug a cord into a wall, push the other end into a small device, and watch a bar fill up.
hints.Wi-Fi: Wave a device around searching, show signal bars with fingers, then relax and sigh when it connects.
hints.satellite: Float high in a slow circle with a stiff arms-out pose, and beam signals down at Earth.
hints.webcam: Stare at a small eye on top of a screen, wave, and adjust it a little.
hints.microphone: Hold a stick to your mouth, tap it, then point it toward a crowd.
hints.video game: Hold a controller with both hands, mash buttons, lean sideways at turns, and cheer or slump.
hints.GPS: Hold a device out in front of you, follow it, turn at every corner, then act lost when it tells you to go back.
hints.hacker: Hunch over a keyboard in a hood, type frantically, look around, and grin when you break in.
hints.remote control: Aim a small thing at a far screen, press buttons, and keep changing what you watch.
hints.electric car: Drive silently with a steering wheel, then plug a long cable in at a stop.
hints.virtual reality: Strap a box over your eyes, reach and grab at things nobody else sees, and duck from them.
hints.artificial intelligence: Act like a robot brain thinking, tapping your head, then nodding calmly and pointing to the answers.
hints.3D printer: Show a machine slowly building up layers from nothing, then pick up the object it made.
hints.QR code: Hold a flat thing up to a small square pattern, wait a moment, then watch a page open.
hints.cloud storage: Throw files up into the sky, and pull them back down from the air on another device.
hints.self-driving car: Sit in the driver seat with your hands off the wheel, relaxed, as it turns by itself.
hints.password: Type secret letters while covering the screen with your hand, then get locked out and slump in frustration.
hints.bluetooth: Hold two small devices close, wait a moment, then show them linking up with your fingers.
hints.search engine: Type a question, press enter, and scroll through a long list, scanning for the answer.
hints.robot vacuum: Crawl in a small round motion across the floor, bump into things, turn, and keep going.
hints.touch screen: Poke, swipe, and pinch the air in front of you with your fingers to move things around.
